verdict.rationale: Ramp ships an official MCP server (support.ramp.com/ramp-mcp) confirmed live via probe, which lets AI agents/assistants operate Ramp via natural-language prompts, plus llms.txt endpoints purpose-built for LLM consumption. Missing for 10: hands-on/community evidence of actual natural-language command usage, and example prompts/outputs showing the MCP server executing real actions.
